assessment.procedure_coverage: Strong, design-only coverage of the existing manual-run case's search and tree controls for member/admin. Guest false applicability matches inventory; the procedure correctly disclaims dispatcher/Ask/Act authorization because ToolsView invokes handler.run directly after Zod parsing. Runtime remains unverified.
assessment.quality: Inputs, handler branches, returned fields, limit/count behavior, tree depth, explicit API errors, fixture isolation, warm/reload repetition, and role handling are source-consistent and executable subject to the documented receipt/resource preflight. It correctly avoids asserting an exact search total because Chrome can match folder metadata.

findings.finding: Cleanup says delete the fixture folder and then verify its entries no longer appear in the scoped tree. Once deleted, the recorded folder ID is no longer a valid getSubTree target, so the specified verification query cannot establish cleanup; it will likely return an API error.
findings.recommendation: Before deletion, record the two exact fixture URLs/titles. After deleting only the fixture folder, verify absence with two exact-title/URL searches in that disposable profile (and record explicit errors separately); do not query the deleted folder ID as the cleanup oracle.

findings.finding: Calling the optional catalog query field 'schema drift' overstates what the source proves: query is optional in the action-discriminated schema, while the handler conditionally requires it only for action=search.
findings.recommendation: Describe this as an action-conditional requirement not represented by the current catalog schema; retain the explicit handler error assertion.

source_checks.search: canonical-mergers.ts validates missing query with the stated reason; browser-data.ts searches, slices to limit, reports total_match, and maps id/title/url/parent/date fields.
source_checks.tree: canonical-mergers.ts delegates folder_id/max_depth; browser-data.ts uses getSubTree for a supplied ID and trims id/title/url/date_added/children by depth. Root/subtree wrapper shape is handled without assuming browser root structure.
source_checks.fixture_and_roles: Synthetic public URLs/titles and per-profile folder IDs are appropriate. Member/admin applicability matches inventory; guest is outside this case. Fixture must be independently seeded and cleaned in each distinct profile.

disposition: procedure is otherwise source-accurate and runnable after cleanup oracle correction; no source or inventory edits made
